cells.gaps: CRIMS is under development and not yet in use at 2026-01-20: O and C are what it is to record, not what any station records, and no station, place or way of making the record is given. The 2023 training for a wide launch (ETH-004) falls outside the 36 months and no launch is recorded since; no plan or finance is stated.
cells.note: A named system, CRIMS, is being built for the Ministry of Justice, the Federal Police and the Addis Ababa Police, on a fact dated inside 36 months. Rung 3 needs it past its pilot and live in stations outside the capital, and the ministry says it is not yet in use.
